title: A path from Spore to Seed
summary:
Spore-to-Seed eligibility got a daily workflow and clearer rules, while the community showcase picked up new apps.

A daily eligibility workflow was added for automatic Spore-to-Seed upgrades. It scores GitHub account age, commits, public repositories, and stars; accounts reaching 8 Dev Points qualify under the implemented rules.

Enter now explains the Dev Points scoring rules and daily evaluation schedule. Pricing tooltips also gained structured content and better positioning when tapped on mobile.

Study Buzz joined the learning catalog with quizzes, flashcards, study guides, and AI help. The README showcase also added ChatPUA, Player or AI, and Filmirror.
